title: The Normal Distribution
learning_objectives: Evaluate the normal density and cumulative probability with math.exp and math.erf
Compute interval probabilities and the 68–95–99.7 rule
Approximate a binomial probability with a continuity correction
Compare a manual formula with statistics.NormalDist
entry_point: normal_pdf(x, mu, sigma); normal_cdf(x, mu, sigma); prob_between(a, b, mu, sigma); empirical_rule(); binomial_cdf_approx(k, n, p)
hints: The empirical rule is `prob_between(-k, k)` for k = 1, 2, 3.

failure_feedback.advice: Divide by `sigma * sqrt(2*pi)` and square `(x - mu)` inside the exponent.
Return a dict keyed by 1, 2 and 3 with `prob_between(-k, k)`.
Use mean n*p, standard deviation sqrt(n*p*(1-p)) and evaluate at k + 0.5.
